content.title: Stage Performance | Wide-Shot Fall and Recovery
content.summary: Begin the solo performance in a wide shot that establishes body and space, move into a close facial beat, complete one controlled fall and hold it from overhead, then let the performer rise inside an isolated beam of light.

quick_start.input_format: Single performer + vast empty space + wide-shot buildup + close facial beat + one controlled fall + overhead confirmation + continuous rise
quick_start.recommended_input: A percussion dancer performs alone in an abandoned observatory, moving from a long shot trajectory to a close-up hand rhythm, completing a knee-first spiral fall to the ground, holding for an overhead shot, and then rising continuously within the open dome's light beam.
required_anchors: Begin by establishing the full body against the vast scale of the space
The close-up must be established after the action language is introduced
There is only one decisive descent throughout the entire film
Use an overhead shot or ground-level camera to confirm the landing
The ending shows the performer rising continuously without returning to the opening composition
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The solo performance first uses a long shot to establish the body and space, then advances the close-up expression, completes a controlled fall to the ground and stays in an overhead shot, and finally rises up in an independent beam of light.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Build a solo performance through a scale-changing camera arc: establish the whole body in a large empty venue, advance to close expressive proof, let the body descend into one floor-level low point, then restore vertical energy in a final isolated light. The reusable template excludes any storyboard or prompt-demo overlay and depends on the visible fall-to-rise performance logic.

invariants.rule: Open with full-body scale inside a visibly larger venue.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening close removes the scale contrast needed later.

invariants.rule: Move closer only after the body's initial movement language is established.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate close coverage turns the piece into a generic portrait.

invariants.rule: Use one controlled descent as the single decisive low point.
invariants.purpose: Gives the performance an irreversible middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated falls become choreography noise rather than structure.

invariants.rule: Hold the low point with a camera relation that proves floor contact and body geometry.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the descent from reading as a cutaway.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hidden landing weakens physical causality.

invariants.rule: End upright in one isolated light, without recreating the opening framing.
invariants.ablation_failure: Returning to the exact opening makes the arc feel reset rather than resolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
